ValidationRule.description: Company Information section, Company Profile section, Goal with Portal field and Function field needs to be complete before change stage to qualified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.Name ='Agent Acquisition', TEXT(Status)='Qualified', OR( ISBLANK(Company),ISBLANK(Website) , ISBLANK(TEXT(Branch_Conflicts_with_Maxway__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT( Head_Office_Country__c )),
ISBLANK(TEXT(Last_Years_Total_Successful_Applications__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Number_Of_Full_Time_Staff__c)), ISBLANK( Study_Abroad_Countries__c ),ISBLANK( Goal_With_Portal__c ), ISBLANK(Top_Sending_Countries__c ), ISBLANK(Function__c),ISBLANK(TEXT(Number_Of_Branches__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All the fields mention in company Information section and Company Profile section should have information to Qualify the Lead.
